materials.content:
Graphite and watercolor on medium thick, beige, slightly textured wove paper [1999 CR lists only graphite and not watercolor.]
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Brown rectangular shape, with darker outline, covers the bottom quarter of the paper. A figure with no facial features, in a blue and white top and a tan hat with a red bow, faces forward right. Background is a blue/yellow wash.
title: Untitled (Figure), 1905/1906 sketchbook
